newsitem.title: UK: Ladbroke makes new appointment at Hilton.
newsitem.headline: Ladbroke makes new appointment at Hilton.

text.p: Britain's Ladbroke Group Plc said on Tuesday it had recruited David Scowsill of British Airways to take up a key post at Hilton International, its hotels division.
Scowsill will become Senior Vice-president - Sales, Marketing and Information Technology at Hilton International.
He will have particular responsibility for the implementation of the sales, marketing and information technology aspects of a worldwide alliance with Hilton Hotels Corp (HHC) announced in August.
Ladbroke and HHC plan to reunite the Hilton brand for the first time since 1964. HHC owns the Hilton name in the U.S. while Ladbroke has the rights to it in the rest of the world.
Scowsill, 40, is currently head of BA's Europe and Middle East region.
